claims: A voice request ('simple React app to track protein and calories day by day') is turned into a working tracker by Claude Code while the creator waits
The app tallies calories, protein, carbs and fats against targets and shows a visual breakdown
Hosting on Vercel keeps it synced across devices
how_to_steps: Speak the app request to the voice agent, which restates it as a spec and confirms
Agent hands the build to Claude Code and reports progress by voice
Agent opens the finished app in the browser and walks through it
Ask the agent for a hosting recommendation (Vercel) to use it on a phone
on_screen_only: Overlay: 'POV: Iron Man was your favorite super hero as a kid and now JARVIS does all of your work for you'
Laptop shows a dark particle/orb visualizer while JARVIS speaks

Browser tab 'Daily Fuel - Nutrition Tracker'; page header 'Daily Fuel  NUTRITION LOG', 'Track what you eat. Know how you feel.', date 'Sunday, March 15', DAILY TOTALS ring gauges for protein and calories, 'Nothing logged yet', 'Add Food' button
'Add Food' modal with fields for food name, calories and protein
